canonicalization.boolean_rule: trim; map true/false case-insensitively to lowercase true/false
canonicalization.missing_values: missing in any key field makes the plant ineligible; missing never equals missing
canonicalization.rule: trim whitespace; parse with decimal.Decimal; serialize format(normalize(), 'f'); no tolerance; no binary float; no chosen decimal places
canonicalization.structure_type: trim surrounding whitespace; do not case-fold

excluded_fields.evidence: P02B contract and BR-PVGen data dictionary: unique plant metadata identifier
excluded_fields.reason: plant identifier; never enters the exact technical key

excluded_fields.evidence: P02B contract; Readme location restricted to federative unit
excluded_fields.reason: state is contextual only; must not create, split, merge, or rank twin groups

group_id_rule: group_id = TW_ + first 12 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 of canonical JSON object in frozen key order

reconstruction.eligible_if: all final key fields non-missing and canonicalizable
reconstruction.group_by: exact equality of the ordered canonical key tuple

is_panel_bifacial_and_panel_bifaciality_.reason: official dictionary defines a boolean module class and a separate rear-to-front ratio; constant sample values are not a documented encoding equivalence

unobserved_technical_configuration.notes: inverter identifiers exist only in time-series files; P02B does not use time-series to define nominal equivalence
